تشترطي (form VIII)
# تَشْتَرِطِي (taštariṭī) /taʃ.ta.ri.tˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
# تُشْتَرَطِي (tuštaraṭī) /tuʃ.ta.ra.tˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
